question.problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & x+2y+6z=5 \\  & y-10z=-11 \\  & 4x+8y+13z=9\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 6 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -10 & -11 \\ 4 & 8 & 13 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 6 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -10 & -11 \\ 4 & 8 & 13 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 6 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -10 & -11 \\ 0 & 0 & -11 & -11\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-\frac{1}{11}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 6 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -10 & -11 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
